units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 51:9">Targ. Ps. LI, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:15">Ib. LXVIII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 3b:12">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מעלי ת׳ וכ׳</he> snow on the mountains is as good as five rains on the ground.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:2-12">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אם … בת׳ ימות</he> if in the morning the ox nearly dies from cold.
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:15">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>לת׳</he> as a remedy for chills.
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>הוו מגנו ליה את׳</he> they made him lie on the snow; a. e.
